Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**GREEN FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (chromatic), lawful evil*
**AC** 21 (natural armor)
**HP** 429 (22d20 + 198)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 60 ft.
**STR** 27 (+8) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 28 (+9) | **INT** 21 (+5) | **WIS** 19 (+4) | **CHA** 22 (+6)
**Saving Throws** Dex +9, Con +16, Wis +11, Cha +13
**Skills** Deception +13, Insight +13, Perception +18, Persuasion +13, Stealth +9
**Immunities** poison
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, poisoned
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 28
**Languages** Common, Draconic
**CR** 24 (62,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +7

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Uncanny Miasma.*** Poison damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to poison damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) poison damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature this way it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Poison Plague or Toxic Suffocation).
• ***Poison Plague.*** The dragon exhales a burst of poison miasma at a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere of skin-melting poison. Each creature within that area must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 78 (12d12) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
• ***Toxic Suffocation.*** The dragon exhales a miasma of toxin that spreads around it in a 100-foot-radius sphere centered on it. The miasma moves around corners and can pour through openings as small as 1 inch wide. Each creature within the sphere must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take 5d12 poison damage and are poisoned. While poisoned this way, creatures take 15d12 poison damage at the start of each of their turns, and can repeat the saving throw at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a success.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Corrosive Shield.*** In response to an attack targeting it, the dragon creates a shell of hardened corrosive ichor surrounding itself, increasing their AC by 5 until the end of the turn. Any attack that hits it breaks the shield and ends this effect, but any creature who makes a melee attack against it and misses from within 5 feet takes 5 (1d10) poison damage.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (1d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage and 6 (1d12) poison damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
***Poison Cyclone (Costs 3 Actions).*** A vortex of poison surges around the dragon. All creatures within 30 feet of it must make a 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and 12 (2d12) poison damage on a failure.
